cause: impl-judge found the workspace-only label gate was an equivalent mutant — removing it changed no observable behavior, because no adapter reads the label outside its workspace-creating call. Bound the guard in its own test rather than leaving a silent-regression seam.

Rebasing onto the advanced target deleted every file the mux half of this CR touched — the multiplexer mechanism moved to an external package that already carries the naming seam. Re-homed the derivation module, retargeted the handoff onto the new seam, and re-cut the mux scenarios to the retargeted node boundary. One pre-existing assertion pinned a backend flag by position and was relaxed to presence: a named workspace spawn now also carries a name flag, which the position had assumed away.
